hero.badge: Enterprise Digital Healthcare Management Platform — Full Health
hero.subtitle: Full Health unifies clinical, administrative, diagnostic, and pharmacy roles into a single high-speed, secure environment for medical excellence, consultation tracking, e-prescriptions, and inventory intelligence.

capabilities.title: Exceptional Capabilities Built for Healthcare Leaders
capabilities.subtitle: Full Health is designed to deliver seamless end-to-end management for hospitals, polyclinics, and medical centers.
capabilities.cap1Desc: Zero-delay synchronization connecting doctors, executives, pharmacy, laboratory, and radiology for immediate order dispatch.
capabilities.cap2Desc: Strict protection of medical records and patient health files with full support for uninterrupted offline operation.
capabilities.cap3Desc: Dedicated workspaces customized for doctors, pharmacists, patients, medical assistants, and diagnostic lab staff.
capabilities.cap4Desc: Automated drug batch tracking, expiration alerts, and 1-click electronic prescription transmission from clinic to pharmacy.

screens.title: Real Screen Showcase of Full Health Platform
screens.subtitle: Carefully engineered interfaces empowering physicians, pharmacists, assistants, and patients. Click any screen thumbnail to view full-resolution lightbox.
screens.s1Desc: Centralized physician dashboard providing an overview of today's encounters, upcoming appointments, and patient statistics.
screens.s2Desc: Organize outpatient clinic operating hours, consultation slots, and break periods.
screens.s3Desc: Detailed view of booked patient queues, waiting lists, and completed medical visits.
screens.s4Desc: Issue and dispatch digital prescriptions directly to the pharmacy with precise dosage instructions.
screens.s5Desc: Order lab test panels directly to the laboratory and track incoming diagnostic results.
screens.s6Desc: Request diagnostic imaging scans and inspect radiologist consultation reports upon completion.
screens.s7Desc: Pharmacy command hub for receiving e-prescriptions, dispensing medications, and tracking stock movement.
screens.s8Desc: Full oversight of pharmaceutical supplies, drug categories, and available stock levels.
screens.s9Desc: Track incoming medical shipments, supplier deliveries, and warehouse stock batches.
screens.s10Desc: Early warning system flagging medications nearing expiration date to guarantee patient safety.
screens.s11Desc: Interactive patient hub to track upcoming visits, medical history, and prescribed medications.
screens.s12Desc: Intuitive booking portal allowing patients to select specialty, physician, and preferred slot.
screens.s13Desc: Historical timeline of all past medical encounters, active bookings, and diagnostic records.
screens.s14Desc: Personal archive for patients to inspect their prescribed medications and dosage instructions.
screens.s15Desc: Empowers medical assistants to manage waiting queues and doctor calendars on behalf of physicians.
screens.s16Desc: Overview of doctors assigned to the assistant for clinic coordination and pre-triage.
screens.s17Desc: Manage specimen collection orders, record lab results, and approve diagnostic reports.
screens.s18Desc: Radiology imaging archive and radiologist reports linked directly to patient files.
screens.s19Desc: Instant alert center dispatching emergency notifications, booking updates, and staff alerts.

modules.title: Functional Modules Covering Every Enterprise Requirement
modules.subtitle: Explore digital solutions designed for physicians, patients, pharmacists, and hospital management.
modules.m1Desc: Live executive command center delivering Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), bed occupancy, and patient flow dynamics.
modules.m2Desc: Comprehensive doctor calendar management, outpatient booking, automated rescheduling, and patient reminders.
modules.m3Desc: Automated waiting hall patient calling system connected to digital display screens, reducing wait times by 45%.
modules.m4Desc: Encrypted digital patient archive containing medical history, allergies, surgical records, and vital sign trends.
modules.m4Feat1: Rapid timeline view of past visits
modules.m5Desc: Receive digital prescriptions instantly from clinics, dispense medications via barcode, and manage stock batches.
modules.m6Desc: Specimen sample management, lab analyzer integration for result ingestion, and instant report generation.
modules.m7Desc: Radiology workflow management supporting imaging scans and radiologist consultation reports.
modules.m8Desc: Dedicated workspace enabling physicians and assistants to view queue lists, document diagnoses, and order tests.
modules.m9Desc: Manage medical staff files, duty shift rosters, attendance, and role-based access permissions per department.
modules.m10Desc: Instant alert system notifying medical teams during emergencies, reminding patients of appointments, and live support.
modules.m10Feat1: Instant ER emergency team dispatch alerts
